provider: Nintendo Switch Online Save Data Cloud

free_tier.stated: No pool at all: one save slot per supported game title. A personal subscription covers one account and a family plan covers eight

per_object_cap.stated: One save data file per software title for each Nintendo Account. There is no aggregate cap and no way to store non-save bytes

retention.stated: Backed-up saves are not usable once the subscription ends, and are accessible again if the subscription is renewed within 180 days

egress.terms: Console-mediated only. There is no HTTP API, so there is no egress path at all

tooling: none public. The switch's own backup menu is the only client
chaining: Nothing to multiply: there is no capacity number to shard, and the practical ceiling is titles owned times per-title save size, which is tens of gigabytes at most

limits.value: one save file per supported title per account
an active Nintendo Switch Online membership is required, and the only client is the console

identity_cost.detail: a Nintendo Account and a paid subscription

reliability_note: Multiple games are excluded from backup entirely, and saves are not usable once the subscription lapses (accessible again on renewal within 180 days). The console is the only client, so there is no programmatic read or write path

evidence.proved: 'You can only back up one save data file per software title for each Nintendo Account' and 'There is no limit to the amount of storage space or number of software titles that can be backed up'
backup requires an active Nintendo Switch Online membership
'Nintendo Switch Online: title-by-title, not a storage pool'
after the subscription ends the backed-up saves are not usable; renewing within 180 days restores access
evidence.quote: if you re-subscribe within 180 days, you will be able to access the save data that was backed up during your previous subscription period.

evidence.proved: one save data file per title per account
evidence.quote: You can only back up one save data file per software title for each Nintendo Account.

evidence.proved: no aggregate storage limit is stated
evidence.quote: There is no limit to the amount of storage space or number of software titles that can be backed up.

evidence.proved: backup needs a Nintendo Switch Online subscription
evidence.quote: Only users (Nintendo Accounts) that have a subscription to Nintendo Switch Online can back up save data.

evidence.proved: a family membership covers up to 8 people
evidence.quote: A family membership provides the Nintendo Switch Online service to everyone in the purchaser's Nintendo Account family group (up to 8 people).

binding_note: The advertised absence of a storage limit is bound to one save file per title, so the per-object cap is the whole quota. There is no pool to measure.
